title: MBZUAI’s IFM Releases PAN 2, an Open 29B World Model for Physical AI
description:

Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, one model with two safeguard levels. Fable 5.2 scores 49.1% on FrontierCode 2.0, costs $8/$40 per million tokens, and ships with a 1M-token context window.
